About

The Hempolics bring organic, rootsy elements back to contemporary reggae. Led by Grippa Laybourne, the band pairs radio-friendly melodies with soundsystem bass. Laybourne spent years recording internationally acclaimed artists before assembling the band to realise his own vision.

Highlights

  • Single Serious reached number one on the UK reggae chart
  • Serious playlisted during Massive Attack's BBC Radio takeover
  • London headline show at 229, May 2026
